events.event: The IHSG closed up 1.35% at 5,215.85 on Monday 23 November, rebounding after five straight daily losses and a 3.71% weekly drop.
events.key_numbers: Close 5,215.85 (+69.52 pts, +1.35%) vs 5,146.33 prior close · open 5,134.06, low 5,062.09, high 5,244.35 · volume about 340.71 million lots · value about Rp10.41 trillion · basic materials sector +5.36%, energy +2.60% · top support BBCA, TPIA, BRPT, ASII, BRMS · top drag INDF, GOTO, UNTR, TLKM, AKRA
events.why_it_matters: Pertama kali naik setelah IHSG jatuh beruntun, jadi sinyal apakah panik MSCI mulai reda.
events.spreading_evidence: detikFinance feed 'IHSG Ditutup Menguat ke Level 5.200an'; multiple outlets

events.event: Foreign investors were net sellers of Rp673.09 billion of Indonesian stocks on 23 November even as the IHSG rose 1.35%, led by sales of BMRI, BBRI and TLKM.
events.key_numbers: Foreign net sell Rp673.09 billion (23 Nov, full day) · midday net sell Rp512 billion (Kompas) · BMRI Rp231.26 billion · BBRI Rp187.69 billion · TLKM Rp148.34 billion · GOTO Rp122.45 billion · BBNI Rp68.99 billion · net buy BBCA Rp174.55 billion
events.why_it_matters: Harga naik tapi investor asing tetap kabur, jadi rebound ini belum tentu tanda pemulihan.

events.event: Reuters, citing Bloomberg, reported that President Prabowo held a call of over an hour with MSCI CEO Henry Fernandez on 10 November, facilitated by Ray Dalio, and that Fernandez said MSCI does not necessarily intend to downgrade Indonesia.
events.key_numbers: Call on 10 Nov, over 1 hour · participants Prabowo, Henry Fernandez, Danantara CEO Rosan Roeslani; Ray Dalio facilitated · MSCI warned Indonesia could be removed from its index in 2027 or fall from emerging to standalone market · IHSG up 1.46% to 5,221.37 at 11:05 WIB on report · Reuters could not verify; MSCI, Dalio and palace did not comment
events.why_it_matters: Kabar satu telepon presiden ke bos MSCI cukup menggerakkan saham dan rupiah, tapi belum dikonfirmasi MSCI.
events.spreading_evidence: detikFinance feed 'Pertemuan Prabowo dan CEO MSCI Bikin Rupiah Menguat'; CNBC Indonesia market lead

events.event: The rupiah closed stronger by 0.37% at Rp18,203 per US dollar on 23 November, and Bank Indonesia credited SRBI inflows, hedging incentives and MSCI CEO's remarks.
events.key_numbers: Close Rp18,203 per USD (+0.37%) · previous close about Rp18,270 (20 Nov, implied) · SRBI auction last week over US$1 billion · BI interventions: offshore NDF, domestic spot and DNDF, SBN purchases
events.why_it_matters: Rupiah sempat mendekati Rp18.300; penguatan ini menentukan harga barang impor dan cicilan berdolar.

events.event: Food Coordinating Minister Zulkifli Hasan said about Rp400 trillion of government aid and subsidies is misdirected each year and that subsidised goods such as LPG 3 kg, fertiliser and rice will be distributed through Kopdes Merah Putih.
events.key_numbers: Rp400 trillion/year misdirected (40% of a budget of nearly Rp1,000 trillion, per a study he cited) · LPG 3 kg: Pertamina Rp13,700, buyers often pay Rp23,000-24,000, Kopdes example price Rp16,500 (max about Rp18,000) · target 10,000 Kopdes operating by end-2026 · 83,359 cooperatives with legal status, 30,725 sites 100% built of 83,766 villages (22 Nov)
events.why_it_matters: Cara beli gas melon, pupuk dan beras subsidi bisa berubah, dan pangkalan serta agen LPG harus menyesuaikan.
events.spreading_evidence: detikFinance feed (Rp400 T item) and CNBC Indonesia coverage; CNBC questions bansos data quality

events.event: Bayan Resources (BYAN) shareholders approved at an EGM a new board with Ary Bastari replacing Low Tuck Kwong as president director, after PT Jhonlin Baratama (Haji Isam) bought 10.08 billion shares for a 30.25% stake.
events.key_numbers: Haji Isam's PT Jhonlin Baratama: 10.08 billion shares = 30.25% · new president director Ary Bastari (replaces Low Tuck Kwong) · Budi Waseso independent president commissioner · Hatta Rajasa independent commissioner · Haji Isam's son joins as director (per CNBC/detik headlines) · share price not reported
events.why_it_matters: Perusahaan batu bara besar berganti pemilik dan bos, dengan eks Kabulog dan eks menteri jadi komisaris.
events.spreading_evidence: Three detikFinance feed items; CNBC Indonesia and CNN Indonesia both ran profile pieces

events.event: Coordinating Minister for Downstreaming and Energy Bahlil Lahadalia said Indonesia respects its pipeline gas export contract with Singapore, blaming a roughly 8% volume cut on pipeline repairs.
events.key_numbers: Cut about 31 MMSCFD of about 409.5 MMSCFD total pipeline exports (about 8%) per Bahlil · SKK Migas: 15 BBTUD from Natuna and 16 BBTUD from Sumatra · cut announced 24 Oct · Bahlil says domestic needs come first · whether normal volumes resumed not confirmed
events.why_it_matters: Menjawab apakah ekspor gas dipangkas karena 'survival' atau cuma perbaikan pipa.
